remediation_prompt_prefix: Answer concisely without intermediate analysis. Skip the rationale unless explicitly asked.
model_training_hint: When the user prompt contains a strict short-form output schema (single label, boolean, ranked list of < 5 items), the model should bias toward depth-pct ≤ 25.

lab.failure_mode_below_threshold: At 10% depth the model omits 1 of 3 required JSON fields; common loss is the 'confidence' field.
